headline: Cà Rốt Production jumps from 740th to 91st on ARC-3

sections.text: Cà Rốt Production added 3.75 points to reach 33.62, rising from 740th to 91st in the past day.
The move carries the team into the board’s top 100, a sharp change in position among 4,780 teams.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
